candidates.description: This vector activates on terms and proper nouns related to Eastern religions, particularly Buddhism and Hinduism, along with their associated philosophies and geographic regions.
German modal and auxiliary verbs expressing necessity, possibility, and permission.
This vector represents German grammatical conjunctions, prepositions, pronouns, and auxiliary verbs commonly used for sentence structure and connection.
Common German verbs and verb stems denoting states, locations, and general actions.
This feature activates on German masculine accusative singular determiners and pronouns, as well as specific sub-word suffixes and lexical roots containing the letter sequence "den".
Common German verbs in various inflected forms.
This feature vector activates on tokens containing the common suffix '-ed' or variations of past-tense verb endings.
These tokens function as German auxiliary verbs, modal verbs, and common action verbs, primarily representing grammatical tense, mood, and predication in the German language.
This vector represents words denoting quantity, number, and variety.
This feature activates strongly on German subordinating conjunctions, relative pronouns, and connecting particles that introduce dependent clauses.
